levels.name: FastAPI Basics
levels.goal: Create and run your first endpoints.

project.brief: Build a small CRUD API and test it from the docs page.
steps: Create the project and install FastAPI
Validate input with a Pydantic model
project.out: A main.py file and a short README.

topics.p: FastAPI turns Python functions into web endpoints. Think of each function as a menu item the server can serve. The decorator says which URL and method triggers it.
topics.sc: Expose a health-check endpoint a monitoring tool can call.
pr: Add a GET /hello endpoint that returns {"message": "Hello, World"}.
Copy the health endpoint and change the path and return value.

topics.p: A Pydantic model is a bouncer for request bodies. Wrong types are rejected before your code runs. FastAPI returns a clear 422 error automatically.
topics.sc: Accept a new product only when price is a number.

o.text:
POST /items {"name": "Pen", "price": "abc"}
-> 422 Unprocessable Entity (price: value is not a valid float)

pr: Add an optional description field (string) to Item.
Use Optional[str] with a default of None.

from typing import Optional

class Item(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price: float
    description: Optional[str] = None
